## Description
Describe the feature you'd like to see in hackpack.

## Use Case
Why would this feature be useful? What problem does it solve?

## Proposed Solution
How should this work? (e.g., a new CLI flag, a new base, a new feature, etc.)

## Example Usage
```bash
# How would users interact with this feature?
hackpack new my-hack --base=ts-nextjs --some-new-feature=value
```

## Alternatives
Are there other ways to solve this problem?

## Additional Context
Any mockups, links, or other information that would be helpful?
